Vorro · every system in your stack, one integration hub — no rip-and-replace
The Integration Pitch

Why Vorro, Why Now

Informed Solutions built its reputation on platforms like InformedINSIGHT and InformedDECISION that turn fragmented public-sector and health data into decisions regulators and hospital boards can act on. The ASEAN expansion Saravanan now leads succeeds or stalls on one unglamorous fact: those platforms are only as good as the data feeding them, and in a region of mixed EHRs, ministry systems and legacy HL7 feeds, that data is scattered by default.

Vorro exists to solve exactly that layer — turning brittle, one-off integrations into a single, standards-based connective layer (FHIR, HL7, C-CDA) that client systems plug into once, instead of Informed Solutions' delivery teams rebuilding point-to-point pipes for every new health system or ministry client across the region.

For a transformation chief building a reference model for ASEAN, that means faster time-to-value on each new engagement, a defensible data-governance story for regulators under Malaysia's PDPA and its regional equivalents, and integration capacity that scales with the pipeline of government and health clients Informed Solutions is now chasing — rather than capacity that caps how many deals the team can actually deliver.
